defensives.name: Frenzied Regeneration
defensives.usage_rule: Use this to heal yourself through bleed or magic damage, since Ironfur's armor does not mitigate those damage types.

defensives.name: Barkskin
defensives.usage_rule: Use this on cooldown while in Bear Form to smooth incoming damage; with the Brambles talent it also deals damage back.

defensives.name: Survival Instincts
defensives.usage_rule: Save this for the most dangerous damage intake or the biggest hits rather than spending it reactively on cooldown.

defensives.name: Bristling Fur
defensives.usage_rule: Use this ahead of a burst of incoming damage so it converts that damage into rage while active.
